name: Protopasta Conductive PLA @base
filament_notes:
Carbon-black-filled conductive PLA. FAQ: 215-230C, run on the hotter side for layer adhesion. TDS: 210-230C, 60C plate, up to 8 mm3/s, 0.4 mm or larger nozzle. Material Data Table: 220C up to 6 mm3/s, 240C up to 12 mm3/s, 55C plate. This profile uses the table's 12 mm3/s cap; the TDS only goes up to 8 mm3/s.
Use Magigoo or glue stick - prints can fuse to the plate. Purge extra on filament changes. The filament is fairly flexible but breaks if bent repeatedly; printed parts are weaker along layer lines. Suited to low-voltage circuits, touch sensors and ESD uses.
